The piece highlights Claudia Zapata‑Cardone’s view that while Hispanic talent is widespread, meaningful career opportunities in aerospace remain scarce. She discusses the Latino Professionals in Aerospace (LPAA) organization’s efforts to create pathways—through mentorship, networking and advocacy—for under‑represented engineers and professionals. The article aggregates related coverage from global news feeds via Google News, underscoring LPAA’s growing visibility within the industry.
